thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: Severity 2 - Tenant-specific prefix cache hit-rate collapse detected for tenant "BlueHarbor" in vpc-dedicated-3. Symptoms: increased latency, backend read amplification, cache evictions. Auto-diagnostic started.

Dina_SRE: I see the alert. pulling metrics now — hit-rate for prefixes starting with "sess:uid:" dropped 95% -> 4% in ~10m. eviction spikes, cache working set ballooned.

Omar_Runtime: rough numbers?

Dina_SRE: sample:
```
cache_capacity=64GB total_used=63.5GB
prefix:sess:uid: hit_rate=0.04 evictions=3200/s cardinality=2.9M
backend_read_rate=1200/s backend_write_rate=900/s
```

Lisa_Eng: BlueHarbor deployed telemetry v3 yesterday that added full user GUIDs to session keys for tracing. probable root cause.

Mike_CSM: i've opened a ticket with them and pinged their infra. also, they reported higher 95th pct latency from app-monitoring.

Dina_SRE: mitigation plan: 1) isolate the tenant from shared cache (bypass) 2) replicate tenant workload to fresh pool 3) push prefix-cardinality guard policy 4) coordinate customer rollback or keying change.

Omar_Runtime: commands:
```
redwoodctl cache set --tenant blueharbor --mode bypass --pool vpc-dedicated-3
redwoodctl pool create --name vpc-dedicated-7 --region us-west-2
redwoodctl pool replicate --from vpc-dedicated-3 --to vpc-dedicated-7 --tenants blueharbor
```

ops-bot: executed: redwoodctl cache set --tenant blueharbor --mode bypass --pool vpc-dedicated-3 :white_check_mark:

Dina_SRE: bypass applied. eviction rate dropped 2800/s -> 500/s in ~2m. backend_read_rate down ~60%.

Lisa_Eng: will notify customer: recommend they rollback the telemetry change and instead send a hashed short id. drafting message.

Mike_CSM: sent message. customer replied: "rolling back telemetry change now. deploying patch to strip GUIDs and replace with 8-char hash. ETA 20 minutes." :thumbsup: 

Omar_Runtime: while they roll back, we should push a short-term tenant policy to cap prefix cardinality and enforce probabilistic tracking.

Dina_SRE: agree. policy draft:
```
redwoodctl tenant-policy set --tenant blueharbor \
  --policy "prefix-cardinality-cap=50000;probabilistic-cache=true;default-ttl=900s"
```

Omar_Runtime: applying policy to canary pool vpc-dedicated-7 now.

ops-bot: applied tenant policy to vpc-dedicated-7 :white_check_mark:

Dina_SRE: canary metrics look good: eviction rate in replica 40/s, hit-rate for main prefixes ~85% (good), flagged keys show many with appended GUIDs.

Lisa_Eng: customer confirmed rollback complete and will redeploy with hashed ids in 12m. requested ETA for cache re-enable.

Eve_PM: suggest we give them conservative 2–3 hour window for full re-enable after policy rollout and validation.

Mike_CSM: customer accepted 3h ETA and appreciated the quick mitigation.

Dina_SRE: handoff: i'll be offline in 45m. Omar, can you own monitoring and the policy rollout? Eve, can you own customer comms and postmortem write-up?

Omar_Runtime: i will take over. will do staged rollout: canary -> 10% pools -> 100% for BlueHarbor. will monitor metrics and have rollback script ready.

Eve_PM: i'll own postmortem and customer summary. tagging legal if SLA impact needs review.

Dina_SRE: incident timeline for entry:
- 21:05 alert: hit-rate collapse detected
- 21:07 auto-diagnostic
- 21:09 cache bypass for tenant
- 21:12 customer notified
- 21:15 replication to fresh pool started
- 21:18 tenant policy canary applied
- 21:25 customer rollback confirmed
- 21:40 monitoring steady; planning re-enable

ops-bot: incident tags applied: severity:2 customer-impact:yes mitigation:bypass,policy-replication

Omar_Runtime: starting staged rollout to additional replica pools now. metrics hooks: tenant_prefix_cardinality, cache_hit_rate, eviction_rate, backend_read_rate.

Lisa_Eng: we should add a runtime guard to reject keys that exceed prefix entropy threshold — opening PR.

Eve_PM: capturing owner assignments. will publish summary to customers/support and internal postmortem doc once complete.

Mike_CSM: BlueHarbor asked for a short-term reimbursement for extra token cost. i'll flag to finance and CS for SLA review.

Dina_SRE: final note before handoff — stable but not fully re-enabled. customer cooperating. root cause: telemetry injecting high-cardinality suffixes into cache keys. next actions: complete policy rollout, coordinate joint deploy with BlueHarbor, full cache re-enable with rollback plan and 24h monitoring.

Omar_Runtime: acknowledged. taking over. :eyes:

Dina_SRE: thanks team, handing off to omar. :wave:

participants: incident-bot, dina_sre, omar_runtime, lisa_eng, mike_csm, ops-bot, eve_pm
